# Halvard Systems Payment and Invoicing Standard

Payment and invoicing standard of Halvard Systems. Synthetic evaluation material for a fictional company.

## Purpose and Scope

This standard sets the invoicing and payment terms Halvard Systems accepts in vendor agreements.

## Standard Payment Terms

Undisputed vendor invoices are payable no sooner than forty-five (45) days after receipt; shorter payment windows require finance approval.

## Late Payment Interest

Interest on late undisputed amounts must not exceed one and a half percent per month.

## Invoice Disputes

Halvard Systems raises invoice disputes in writing within twenty business days, and the undisputed portion remains payable.
